title: 30% off Recurring Discount - Australian NVMe Web Hosting from $4.20/Month @ Hosting Grid
body:
Deal: 30% off Recurring Discount - Australian NVMe Web Hosting from $4.20/Month @ Hosting Grid

[Thiefsie] just wondering If i upgrade in place from Seed to grower (as you know, I'm a grower) is the discount grandfathered in?
[Hosting Grid] Ha, good one. Yes mate, fully grandfathered. Upgrade in place from Seedling to Grower whenever you like and the 30% carries over, so Grower works out to $8.40/mo for life instead of $12. Same again if you ever jump to Powerhouse. You only pay the pro rata difference at upgrade time, no new signup, no losing the discount.
[Thiefsie] OK thanks. looks like a good deal for the person who doesn't want a VPS and all that it entails.
[Thiefsie] any thoughts on hermes on grower instead of OC? (If possible) not being VPS)
[CantonasKungFuKick] Would this work for moving a wordpress hosted website/s? How does it work with email accounts?
[Hosting Grid] Yep, that's exactly what the free migration is for. You sign up, open a ticket with your current host's login details (or a cPanel/backup file if you prefer), and we move the WordPress site/s over for you, usually same day. We test it on a temporary URL first, and you only flip your domain across once you're happy, so no downtime.
Email accounts come included on every plan, no extra cost. We migrate your existing mailboxes and messages across too (works from most hosts), then you just update the mail settings on your devices, or use webmail. Standard IMAP/SMTP so it works with Outlook, Apple Mail, phones, all the usual.
If you've got multiple sites, Seedling handles unlimited addon domains, so they can all live on the one plan as long as they fit in the 10GB.
[royale] Are you using cpanel for email hosting? Which means the calendar and contacts doesn't work on Outlook (especially Outlook Mac), since it doesn't support CALDAV and CARDAV?
[Hosting Grid] No cPanel here, we're on Enhance. Mail itself is standard IMAP/SMTP so it works fine in Outlook including Mac, but you're right about the sync side, the included mailboxes don't do CALDAV/CARDDAV so no calendar or contacts sync. I won't pretend otherwise. If synced calendars and contacts are a must have, the proper fix is a Microsoft 365 mailbox and we sell those too, so you can mix and match. Cheap included mailboxes for the info@ type addresses, M365 on the one or two that live in Outlook. Open a ticket and I'll sort out what combo makes sense for you.
[royale] Would you be able to help migrating dockers app currently running on railway?
[Hosting Grid] Good question. Short answer is it depends on the app. We're web hosting, not a container platform like Railway, so we can't just spin up any docker image. If it's PHP, WordPress, static site or a normal web stack we can absolutely get it going here and help you move it over. If it needs its own runtime or background workers etc then shared hosting won't cut it and I'd rather say that upfront than take your money and disappoint you. Let me know what you're running and I'll give it to you straight.
[Hosting Grid] Quick update for anyone migrating: our importer handles cPanel and Plesk automatically. If you're coming from DirectAdmin or any other panel, it's a manual migration on our end, still free, just raise a support ticket after you sign up and we'll move your sites and mailboxes across for you.
[MS Paint] 4.20/Month
A good reason alone to sign up hey @Jimothy Wongingtons
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Can’t tell if rep is a certified marketing genius or coincidences DO happen
[Hosting Grid] Can neither confirm nor deny. The 30% code did the maths, I just hit publish. Happy little accident either way.
[xNik] Definitely good pricing for the month-to-month payer. And the Seedling plan is hard to beat. The rest aren't as competitive if you like or are able to pay 48 months upfront.
[Hosting Grid] Fair call! The 48-month upfront deals are great value if you don't mind handing over 4 years of hosting money in one go, the catch is usually the renewal price in year 5. We keep billing to monthly or annual on purpose, hardware costs move around too much to promise sensible 4-year pricing, and honestly most people don't want to be locked in that long anyway. With OZB30 the 30% off is recurring for life, so your price stays put at renewal, no surprises. Also worth peeking at the specs side by side, our bigger plans get you more RAM and CPU, not just more storage, which is where a lot of the cheap long-term plans go a bit light.
[KungFuK] This is a good deal! Any chance you looking for platform engineer/devops? 🤣🤣🤣🤣
[Hosting Grid] Haha appreciate it mate. Right now the whole team is me, sales, support and platform engineering all answer to the same bloke. Maybe one day though! Glad you like the deal
